'''Chando Tondra''' is a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who is head of the [[Tondra clan]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The clan harvest and process the [[Algae/Legends|algae]] that grows in the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="GG2-2" />
